design_philosophy.vibe: Authority, Clarity, Truth, Premium SaaS, Linear/Vercel Aesthetic
design_philosophy.description: Clean minimalism, generous white space, geometric sans-serif for clear hierarchy, subtle interactions without overwhelming. Uses HTML/Tailwind for mockups where possible, and generated abstracts for rich visuals.

surfaces.tracing_beam_card: relative rounded-xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden group hover:border-blue-500/50 transition-colors

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-bold text-slate-900
scale.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl tracking-tight font-semibold text-slate-900
scale.label: text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-blue-600

structure: Hero (Headline, Subhead, Primary/Secondary CTAs, Dashboard Mockup image or HTML mockup, Floating Stats)
Interactive Demo ('Explore RouteMail in Action' Tabs: Dashboard, Campaign, Drip, Warmup, Analytics - mock UI in pure HTML/Tailwind)
Features (5 sections: Multi-Account, Campaign Builder, Drip Campaigns, Email Warmup, Suppression - alternate left/right with text + image/mockup)
Use Cases (Grid of 5 personas: Agencies, Recruiters, Consultants, Founders, Sales)
Why RouteMail (List of benefits: Smart rotation, Warmup, etc.)
Footer (Links to /blog, /privacy, /terms, /anti-spam, /gdpr, support email. NO 'Developed by Perfect Digitals')
Usage Tracker (Contacts Used / Monthly Limit, Progress Bar)
Helper Text Box ('A contact only counts once per month...')
Subscription.jsx.notes: Must reuse the exact same <CustomPlanCard /> component as the landing page to ensure consistency.

custom_plan_logic.dropdown_instruction: Implement a real <select> (or Shadcn Select). When selection changes, dynamically update the displayed price ($199/year etc). The CTA should pass this value to the existing stripe checkout logic.

images.description: High-end sleek UI mockup of an email marketing dashboard
Minimalist UI interface mockup of a campaign builder

icons.instruction: Use lucide-react for all standard icons. No external image logos needed unless explicitly provided.

media.mockups_strategy: For sections without generated images (Drip Campaigns, Warmup, Analytics, Suppression), strongly prefer building abstract, simplified UI mockups using pure HTML/Tailwind CSS blocks (glassmorphism cards, colored dots, progress bars, workflow node representations) rather than relying on placeholder images. This elevates the 'Premium SaaS' feel.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY. All interactive elements MUST have a semantic kebab-case data-testid (e.g., 'data-testid="start-free-trial-btn"', 'data-testid="pricing-custom-select"', 'data-testid="faq-accordion-1"').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Gray text should be slate-600 minimum.
